title.zh: Standard Chartered plans institutional crypto custody in Singapore
title.en: Standard Chartered plans institutional crypto custody in Singapore

current_state.zh: Standard Chartered announced plans to launch digital asset custody in Singapore for institutional and accredited corporate clients, covering select cryptocurrencies, stablecoins and tokenized real-world assets, subject to regulatory requirements.
